FORMAL INDEPENDENT REVIEW — APPROVE cand-71VW01J0YSMQ72C1VR2MTWJXA9, exact 4cd11ca55e8c626455887c5265a82da76f173e64 over direct parent 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5.

I read the complete candidate mission.md and vision.md and the full two-file diff. Scope is exactly those two paths; git diff --check passes; both files have no line over 100 columns. Exact candidate blobs are mission 0934a89812aa69afc2daf1b6b7d1662ae0b568ff and vision 27267a2b5b0f76facde93512ece1123031fe3ac8.

Provider/consumer boundary: accepted. storymodel4s owns scientific meaning and packet-specific compilation; StoryAtlas owns pagination, device geometry, lowering, interaction, accessibility, and receipts. Recall and interview remain their own provider artifacts, Intaglio remains a backend rather than an ontology, and no renderer-side scientific completion or inference is introduced.

Bundle truth: accepted. The mission now distinguishes conditional canonical StoryModelCodec bytes from the separate always-present result; refusal cannot mint an empty model; invocation, target universe, semantic outcome, per-report outcomes, and delivery failure remain independent; three text identities stay separate; HTML is a report; Unestablished cannot produce a rate; ViewBasis comes from admitted provenance. The wording does not pre-decide the still-open detailed policy for a partial draft-model artifact.

Film: accepted. It is explicitly long-term, uses synchronized but non-equivalent frame, shot, soundtrack, dialogue, and transcript axes, requires exact identities/timestamps/evidence/receipts, and cannot enter StoryAtlas until storymodel4s defines the provider contracts. Transcript is not promoted to the canonical film axis and no current film-support claim is made.

Evidence and geometry: accepted. Marks may resolve through evidence chains or explicit typed absence/outcome/provenance; semantic identity and truthful OnMark/ViaAncestor/OffProjection placement survive while incidental geometry may change. Textual-twin obligations are correctly scoped to produced scientific visual reports rather than binary or refused roles.

O3: accepted with a binding interpretation already established by the governing board. The drawn repeated-endpoint case may decide Tier-1 representational sufficiency: identity, evidence, focus, suppression, occlusion, keyboard, non-colour, and textual equivalence. It cannot support a human usability, task-accuracy, navigation-loss, or preference claim; those remain a separately governed Tier-2 study and never a build gate. The candidate itself makes no such human-performance claim.

The second materially different narrative fixture is correctly a gate on generality rather than an assertion that Araby is required. Current WOG-only capability remains honestly bounded. This is a documentation-contract approval only, not runtime, provider-API, dependency, implementation, authorization, or landing evidence.

Current ledger note: landability still reports git_evidence_stale for a later proposal op in addition to missing review/authorization. Registering this review does not cure that; refresh exact git evidence after this review, and Chief remains the sole authorizer.
